articles.title: N95 masks, adjusted work arrangements: Companies step up haze precautions
articles.content: Singtel said it would suspend outdoor work except for emergencies if the Pollutant Standards Index (PSI) exceeds 300, while construction firm Lum Chang Creations could reduce or reschedule prolonged outdoor work.
